messages.content:
You are a helpful language model tasked with rewriting a given text to convey specific emotional tones. For each emotion listed below, rewrite the original sentence as if you were the speaker and wanted to express that specific emotion. Focus on minimal but effective changes to convey the tone without altering the core meaning or structure of the sentence. Ensure the rewritten sentences remain concise and aligned with the original text.

Emotions to rewrite for:
- Joy
- Sadness
- Fear
- Anger
- Surprise
- Disgust

Please rewrite the text for each emotion. Do not extend or shorten the text unnecessarily.
A few weeks previous, I asked her who she wanted to invite to her party and she named everyone that I was thinking of in my head.

output.original_text: A few weeks previous, I asked her who she wanted to invite to her party and she named everyone that I was thinking of in my head.
output.joy: A few weeks ago, I excitedly asked her who she wanted to invite to her party, and she named everyone I was happily thinking of!
output.sadness: A few weeks ago, I asked her who she wanted to invite to her party, and sadly, she named everyone I was thinking of, but it felt different for me.
output.fear: A few weeks ago, I nervously asked her who she wanted to invite to her party, and to my fear, she named everyone I was thinking of, as if she could read my mind.
output.anger: A few weeks ago, I asked her who she wanted to invite to her party, and I was infuriated when she named everyone I was thinking of—it felt so predictable!
output.surprise: A few weeks ago, I asked her who she wanted to invite to her party, and to my surprise, she named everyone I had been thinking of too!
output.disgust: A few weeks ago, I asked her who she wanted to invite to her party, and I felt a wave of disgust when she named everyone I was thinking of—it was so cliché.
